answer: A hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The spiral counter is kept in glacier and willow shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 716 identities multiplies that fee by 721 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
